verdict.rationale: Hightouch Events documents an HTTP Tracking API for server-side ingestion, including a batch endpoint, alongside backend SDKs, so the core server-to-server ingestion path exists. However, the only authentication evidence covers the separate management REST API (bearer token), not the events collector, and nothing describes delivery guarantees. missing for 10: documented authentication for the events HTTP API, delivery guarantees (retries, acknowledgements, durability or ordering semantics), independent or hands-on corroboration of the ingestion API.
